negative_reviews.author: Karena
negative_reviews.text:
I have been a regular customer here and have always had great experiences, but unfortunately, today’s visit was disappointing.

We specifically asked whether the lunch menu was still available and made it clear that we wanted to order from it. However, I ordered Karaage but was served Teriyaki chicken instead. When I questioned it, the staff member confidently that it was what I had ordered.

To make matters worse, the bill came to over £57. I had to point out that we had ordered two lunch menus. Thankfully, another male staff member corrected the bill.

I believe the service quality needs improvement. Staff should have a better understanding of the menu and the restaurant’s products to provide a more professional and reliable service.
